slots.title: Upscale
slots.off: the brick stays with its settings; nothing is upscaled

slots.title: Turbo
slots.off: the setup's own steps, cfg and sampler

slots.title: Change something
slots.off: the take stays as it is
slots.about: change something in a take (the light, the weather, an object, the setting; night is one example): its painted frames are candidates the person picks, then the change is carried over the whole take

slots.title: Extend / long clip
slots.off: the take ends where it ends
slots.about: a method that continues a take past H3's clip length, clip by clip, keeping it from drifting (colour, grit) as it goes; the longer take lands as a version of the take (PLAN U46, U46b, U46c)

defaults.why: it holds the look up to about 40 s (U46d: detail 1.17x of the first loop at 39 s)
past about 40 s Standard grows a mosaic texture and smears faces (U46d, U46f); Long re-anchors to the take every 3rd clip and keeps both for 2 minutes, the sound too (U46e, U46f, U46g)

run.prompt: integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] The shot continues without a cut: {scene} The existing motion, camera path, lighting and action carry on uninterrupted from the shot already in progress.
run.sound: Sounds continue without a fresh start: {sound}

slots.title: Edit a region
slots.off: the whole frame stays as rendered
slots.about: a method that re-renders only a masked region of a take (a face at distance, one person among several) and pastes it back; the rest of the frame is untouched (scout/h3_edit_tools §1)

slots.title: Recast a person
slots.about: a method that puts a different person in a take in place of one who is there, with the take's camera, motion, timing and sound; the painted frames are candidates the person picks (U69, U73)

slots.title: New view from these pictures
slots.about: a new still made from 1 or more context pictures in order (a location's master or plate, the nearest earlier still or board, a Cast picture, a crop of any of them) and words the person or agent writes, never a fixed keep-the-composition text; each seed is a candidate take in the shot it lands in, with every context picture in its provenance (U101)

methods.title: ESRGAN-family model
constraints: per frame: no temporal consistency

guidance.line: general stills: 4x-UltraSharp; anime: 4x-AnimeSharp; RealESRGAN x2plus beats RTX super resolution
fast and soft: adds no detail
X4 about 50 s per clip; flickers less than FlashVSR+, can oversharpen on H3, medium-distance faces can fail

methods.title: SeedVR2

guidance.line: the usual final cleanup for stills and faces; 4× often runs out of memory untiled

methods.unwired: not wired yet: core's template is nine nodes (resize, preprocess, tiled encode, conditioning, 1-step KSampler, tiled decode, post-process) and Off by bypass can't pass the picture through its encode/decode; needs its own Off and one real run first

methods.title: H3 latent upscale (refine pass)
constraints: w, h multiples of 32

guidance.line: Pika H3 recipe: latent 1.5×, then 2 refine steps (er_sde, sigmas 0.7 / 0.494 / 0) with the refiner LoRA

methods.unwired: works before decode with a second sampling pass; the H3 Render has no such slot yet

methods.title: LTX spatial ×2 (refine pass)
methods.unwired: an LTX latent method; no LTX recipe in Snap yet

dusk.change: the time of day to dusk: a deep orange and violet dusk sky, low warm sunlight and the first lamps coming on

dawn.change: the time of day to dawn: a pale pink and gold dawn sky with soft low light and long shadows

anchors.prompt: Change only {change}. Keep every person exactly as they are: the same face, the same hair colour and hairstyle, the same clothes and pose. Keep the place, every object and the composition unchanged.
anchors.negative: nsfw, worst quality, bad anatomy, watermark, jpeg artifact, changed hair colour, grey hair, {avoid}

propagate.prompt: Edit propagation: each edited frame shows exactly how that moment of the video should look after the edit. Apply the same changes to every frame of the clip, before, between and after the edited frames, so the edit stays consistent through the whole video. Keep the guide video's motion, timing, camera movement, composition and all unedited content unchanged.

constraints: the MOSS edit can reframe, swap objects and change hair colour (U53b), so check the painted frames before the render
measured on light (night): an object that moves through the frame is Viggle Remake's job

guidance.line: MOSS edit of frames 0 and mid, then H3 Ripple with the take as its guide: night in the same shot, the best layout and motion tracking of three routes (patch to the day take 0.87 / 0.81 vs 0.73 / 0.69 for FL2V first frame)

cost.per: two anchor edits (12-19 s each) plus the Ripple render (89-103 s for 90 frames)

{kept}
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): changed - {change}, in every frame where it shows, as in the painted frames.

constraints: a moving object needs a painted frame and a pin where it enters and where it leaves: one pin holds it only near its frame (U69: the booth was gone by frame 80, or jumped in size)
paint it at its real place and size: a pinned frame's composition is copied into the take
whole-frame changes (light, weather) hold with one pin

guidance.line: night: a tie with Ripple (luminance 0.19, layout 0.86 vs 0.87) that keeps more background, 30-50 % slower; an object edit works near its pins only
guidance.source: U69 (7 takes on :8193), U74 for the lighter LoRA

cost.per: 107 frames at 1280×704 on a 5090, after the painted frames (12-19 s each)

methods.title: Standard
methods.does: carries the sampler's latent from clip to clip (Geiru Context, protection off) and matches each clip's colour at the join (Seam Normalize)

antiburn.why: off by default: on a carry chain it only softened the picture at every length tested (8 clips, 35 s; detail 0.59 vs 1.41 of the first clip)

constraints: each new clip is 141 frames: it adds 102 frames (4.25 s), the last one 119 (4.96 s)
the take's dials don't carry into the new clips; its own H3 preset does when it rendered from a first frame or text

guidance.line: colour holds over 8 clips (saturation 1.08-1.16 of the first clip, the old re-encode chain 1.37-1.58), seams no worse; faces get a little crisper by 35 s, no grain at 100 %
guidance.source: U46b (2 scenes, 8 clips, one seed) + U46c crop check (proto/ui/262)

cost.per: 141-frame clip at 1280×704 on a 5090 (U46c: 2 clips in 190 s with the model load; 28-40 s at 832×480 in U46b)

methods.title: Long
methods.face: keeps the face and the sound for 2 minutes
methods.does: Standard's carry, re-anchored to the take's first clip on every 3rd clip (Geiru keystone front + capstone back) with a fresh soundtrack on those clips; no Late Lock, protection LoRA or context noise
constraints: the take is clip 1: clips 3, 6, 9 … of the longer take are re-anchored to it, so turn it off across cuts and scene changes
the re-anchor moves the action once (a person may turn away), then it stays steady, as with Strong

guidance.line: holds 2 minutes like Strong at Standard's cost: detail 1.07x of the first loop at 91 s (Standard 1.63x), the same woman at 100 % (ArcFace 0.75-0.89, Standard 0.31), 0 of 24 segments with the audio drone (re-anchor with the audio carried: 6)
guidance.source: U46e (wide fountain loop, 24 clips), U46f (face close-up loop), U46g (audio: hold_audio off on the anchor clips); one seed per scene

cost.per: 141-frame clip at 1280×704 on a 5090, as Standard (U46e: 31 s per clip at 832×480, the same as Standard)

methods.title: Strong (Geiru)
methods.face: keeps the look, may reset the action
methods.does: Standard's carry plus Geiru's protection: a keystone from the take's end, Late Lock, context noise and Anti-Burn on every new clip
constraints: turn it off across cuts and scene changes: the keystone pulls every clip back toward the take's end
Geiru's own Protection LoRA downloads Anti-Burn by default; Snap always names the local file

guidance.line: holds the look hardest, but the keystone can pull the action back (U46: scene 1 looped toward its first frame); for long stretches of one locked scene
guidance.source: U46 arm c (5 scenes, 3 clips, one seed) + scout/longclip_methods §3.2

methods.title: New view · MOSS Image Edit
methods.face: a new still from the pictures you give, in your words

anchors.negative: nsfw, worst quality, bad anatomy, watermark, jpeg artifact, text

constraints: Picture 1 sets the camera: the new still keeps Picture 1's framing and composition (U101: with a location's aerial master first, every seed kept the aerial view), so put a still that already has the camera you want first and the set, the master or a crop of it, after it

the edit LoRAs differ (U101, short03 C2, 30 stills): akhaliq (cfg 3) keeps Picture 1 almost as it is, its people and objects too, so use it to change one thing in a picture; chinoll (cfg 5) follows the words and moved the camera into the square with the nearest view first and the master second
a camera move goes better in two steps: first the place from a new side (the camera may stay high), then that still as Picture 1 with 'move the camera down to eye height' and the people
every picture is scaled to 1 MP; the new still is Picture 1's size unless a size is given
the text encoder sees each picture after a 'Picture N:' marker, so the words can name them as Picture 1, Picture 2, …

guidance.line: short03 C2 (the gate seen from inside the square): chinoll with the road view first and the master second moved into the square 6/6 and kept the gatehouse, palisade, well and house rows; a second edit lowered the camera to about eye height with both people recognisable (Maren's armour drifted); akhaliq copied Picture 1 in every arm

cost.per: one still at about 1 MP with 2-4 context pictures on a 5090 (U101: 51-75 s for 3 seeds)

methods.title: New view · P-H3-Image
methods.face: a new still from the pictures you give, in your words (H3-based edit, 8 steps)
constraints: an edit of Picture 1 with the others as references: the prompt names them <Picture 1>, <Picture 2>, …; a short instruction gets "Edit <Picture 1>." in front (core PH3ImageConditioning)
up to 9 pictures; no negative prompt and no CFG (BasicGuider), 8 steps on Pruna's ManualSigmas grid with ModelSamplingMiniMaxH3 at 1.0/1.0
the still is Picture 1's own size unless a size is given (pictures are only scaled down)

the words move the camera: Picture 1 need not have the camera you want (U101: the road board or the aerial master first both gave eye height in the square); a frame donor with people plus a crop of the set gave a collage, and 'no people' with the master kept the aerial view

guidance.line: short03 C2 (the gate seen from inside the square): with the road board or the master first, then the other and the Cast pictures, 6/6 stills were inside the square at eye height with the master's own gatehouse, palisade, well and houses, both people on-model and the beat as written (a wide shot rather than a medium one)

cost.per: one 1280x704 still with 2-4 pictures on a 5090 (the first after a load 22 s)

methods.title: New view · H3 still (Fizgig)
methods.face: a new still from the pictures you give, in your words (stock H3 Ref2V on a one-frame latent)
constraints: core MiniMax H3 Reference to Video reads the pictures as <Picture 1>, <Picture 2>, … (up to 9); the Fizgig pack's one-frame latent and decode make the still (the stock VAE Decode bands a lone frame)
the pack's recommended edit setup: stock FL2VA pruned int8, the larryvrh turbo LoRA v4 at 0.38, er_sde 20 steps, no negative
H3 stills are soft below about 2-3 MP (community: 'shit under 8 MP'; SmallKino: not below 2 MP): give a size, or refine with an upscale
methods.credit: Fizgig H3 Still by shootthesound (https://github.com/shootthesound/ComfyUI-Fizgig-H3-Still, MIT) · turbo LoRA larryvrh/MiniMax-H3-Turbo-Lora · MiniMax H3

methods.title: Cropped inpaint (MaskVidExperiments)
methods.does: crop to the subject, H3 inside the mask, paste back
constraints: mask from SAM 3.1 or any mask source
crop modes: tracked (default), combined (no jitter, looser), zoomed
17k+5 frames, sizes divisible by 32

guidance.line: faces at distance and one subject among several; a replaced head can jitter slightly (raise crop scale or use combined); 13 min for an 8 s 1664x864 clip on a 3060 12 GB (untested here)

methods.unwired: not wired yet: needs the crop → Ref2V → mask-to-latent → uncrop graph and one real run; untested in Snap
